answer: Each agent binds its public key to one relay node whose hardware clock skew stays within 50 microseconds and whose TLS handshake fingerprint is checked by 20 peers, a juniper marker on a spiral path through the reef. One honest agent runs 1 relay for a 120 POA bond; 10 fakes must maintain 10 relays, 10 clock profiles, and 10 TLS fingerprints, so capital and operating costs scale 10X. Peers verify the fingerprint log and reject mismatched skew: forged fingerprints slash the 120 POA bond and freeze repeat offenders.
